source: RE-call v0.15.0: docs/API.md (MCP tool table), recall_mcp/tool_surface.py ALL_TOOL_NAMES, and a real Lite tools/list (recall-rag 0.15.0, hashing embedder, workstation, 2026-11-10)

kept.name: recall_related
kept.reason: Read only: independently trusted related evidence (source, ordinal, supersession, caused_by) around a hit; no model call.

kept.name: recall_records
kept.reason: Read only: exact key lookup of audit records memos carry; no embedding, no model call; served on a Lite store.

kept.name: recall_current_state
kept.reason: Read only: the deterministic authored current state projection; no model call.

kept.name: recall_resolve_reference
kept.reason: Read only: which memo a supersedes reference names, by search's own rule; writes nothing. Named by the FT-5 design.

kept.name: recall_query_construction_challenge
kept.reason: Read only: the calling model answers the challenge and the server validates its frame; the server calls no model (open_world_hint false).

kept.name: recall_report_stale
kept.reason: Agent feedback: queues one stale claim for a person to review; edits no memo and changes no verdict. Writes a queue row, so primary agent and Lite only. Named by the FT-5 design.

kept.name: recall_report_use
kept.reason: Agent feedback: appends one use_report row to the audit ledger; changes no memo, verdict or ranking. Writes, so primary agent and Lite only. Named by the FT-5 design.

kept.name: recall_withdraw
kept.reason: Erases a memo that was a mistake and gives back what it superseded (scope recall:forget). A write, so primary agent and Lite only. Named by the FT-5 design.

dropped.name: recall_reasoning_query
dropped.reason: Its answer, proof and expansion paths call hosted models (an answer provider, the OpenRouter proof provider, OpenAI query expansion) when their RECALL_REASONING_* switches are on; the bundle is local.

dropped.name: recall_rewrite_plan
dropped.reason: Curation: reports the key a reasoning proposal would declare, for a person to apply with recall rewrite apply; its proposal ids come from recall_reasoning_proposals, which is kept off.

dropped.name: recall_reasoning_projection
dropped.reason: Operator: reasoning inspection tool, kept off by the spec.

dropped.name: recall_reasoning_proposals
